svg.title: BSWorld architecture with BSController
svg.desc: Native, UML and Bumble Hosts connect to individual BSController workers over H4 Unix sockets. The workers, Bumble Host and simulation clock run inside the pytest process. Each worker connects through a radio FIFO to the shared BabbleSim PHY and writes an HCI capture with simulation timestamps. The native Host and pytest connect to the PHY through clock FIFOs. The UML process receives simulation time from pytest over a time-travel socket. The PHY supplies the radio trace.
svg.text: Bluetooth Hosts on a shared BabbleSim PHY and simulation clock
BLE modem · channel attenuation · shared simulation time
RF capture from every radio on the PHY
H4 Unix socket · HCI between Host and Controller
Radio FIFO · Controller or interference source to the PHY
Clock FIFO · Host or framework simulation clock
Time-travel socket · UML guest clock from pytest
